All schemas are JSON Schema draft-07, additionalProperties false at every object level, with $id under https://dopemux.dev/schemas/governed_execution/<name>.schema.json and a schema_version const of the form dopemux.governed_execution.<name>.v<N>. pr.title: feat(governance): W01 Governed Execution Contract v2 schema foundation
pr.body:
## Summary
- W01 of MACRO-DMX-GOVERNED-EXECUTION-CONTRACT-V2-001, stacked on PR #1337 (kit clean-r1)
- repo-owned schemas under schemas/governed_execution/: enums v1, macro_packet v2, execution_binding v2, task_packet v2, admission/writer_custody/freeze/finality receipts v1, aggregate_return_envelope v1, manifest v1 binding kit v1 schemas by sha256
- positive/negative fixtures, DAG closure, authority-collision, enum-consistency and v1->v2 compatibility tests
- reference doc docs/03-reference/governance/governed-execution-contract-v2.md

## Authority
Schema-valid is not authority-valid. Every schema carries authority NONE. No runtime, dispatch, merge or activation behaviour.

## Validation
L2: deterministic verify list in the packet; kit tests unchanged (43 passed); final independent A1 audit after content freeze by a non-Anthropic-family auditor.

MERGE_AUTHORIZED=NO ACTIVATION_AUTHORIZED=NO

steps.task: Identity, base and custody preflight; no edits until every check passes.

Record sha256 of .control-tower/schemas/supervisor_macro_packet.schema.json and .control-tower/schemas/execution_binding.schema.json at HEAD for the manifest.
Kit tests pass (43) before any change.
validation: All commands exit 0; ANCESTOR_OK printed; 43 passed.
Mismatch on any identity item is STOP_WRONG_BASE with no edits.

requirements: enums.v1.schema.json defines, as named definitions consumed by $ref: status_class {PASS,FAIL,UNKNOWN,NOT_RUN}; preflight_class {OBSERVED,CONFLICTING,UNKNOWN,NOT_RUN}; risk_lane {L0,L1,L2,L3}; dispatch_qualification {DISPATCHABLE,BLOCKED,NEEDS_SUPERVISOR}; drift_class {IDENTICAL,SUBSET,SUPERSET,COMPATIBLE,CONFLICTING,UNKNOWN}; join_type {ALL_REQUIRED,ANY_ONE,QUORUM,ORDERED,OPTIONAL_SIBLING,CONDITIONAL}; workstream_status {NOT_STARTED,IN_PROGRESS,PASS,BLOCKED,NEEDS_SUPERVISOR,FAIL,SUPERSEDED}; macro_status {PASS_IMPLEMENTATION_PROGRAM_COMPLETE,PARTIAL_BLOCKED,BLOCKED,BLOCKED_TEAM_LEAD_ROUTE_UNPROVEN,NO_LEGAL_EXECUTION_ROUTE,GLOBAL_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT,ARCHITECTURE_INVARIANT_BROKEN,NO_VALID_ROLLBACK_FOR_REQUIRED_MUTATION,OPERATOR_GATE_REQUIRED_FOR_ALL_REMAINING_WORK}; audit_verdict {PASS,PASS_WITH_RISKS,FAIL,NEEDS_SUPERVISOR,NOT_RUN}; independence_class {DIFFERENT_FAMILY,DIFFERENT_RUNTIME,DIFFERENT_FAMILY_AND_RUNTIME,SAME_FAMILY_DIFFERENT_SESSION,UNKNOWN}; identity_layer {REQUESTED,CONFIGURED,RESPONSE_CLAIMED,PROXY_REPORTED,PROVIDER_ATTESTED}; freeze_state {FROZEN,UNFROZEN,SUPERSEDED}; also reusable pattern definitions git_oid, sha256, rfc3339_utc.

manifest.v1.json lists every schema in schemas/governed_execution/ with {path, schema_version, status: ACTIVE|ADOPTED|DEPRECATED, sha256} and binds the two kit v1 schemas as status ADOPTED with their sha256 from S0, plus compatibility rules: v1 accepted, v2 preferred, additive-only, deprecation requires a MacroPacket-authorized successor. The manifest's own sha256 entries are verified by test.
validation: PARSE_OK printed; every enum listed above present exactly once.

steps.task: Publish macro_packet.v2 and execution_binding.v2 as additive successors of the kit v1 schemas.
requirements: execution_binding.v2 keeps every v1 property with identical types and adds, all required: runner_version (string), effort_requested (string), effort_observed (string), auth_profile_ref (string), network_posture (string), containment_posture (string), fallback_outcome {fallback_used: boolean, fallback_reason: string}, response_claimed_model (string), provider_attested_model (string), independence_class ($ref enums), qualification_receipt_ref (string), macro_id (string, now required). schema_version const dopemux.governed_execution.execution_binding.v2; authority const NONE.

macro_packet.v2 keeps every v1 property and: joins[].join_type ($ref enums join_type, required) with condition retained; joins[].quorum (integer, required only when join_type is QUORUM, enforce with if/then); workstreams[].audit_group (string, required); workstreams[].return_contract (array of the MACRO section 16 field names, required, minItems 1); team_lead.binding_policy (string, required); global_stop_conditions and immediate_return_triggers retained. schema_version const dopemux.governed_execution.macro_packet.v2; issued_by const control_tower_supervisor.
A v1-shaped instance must remain valid against the kit v1 schema (untouched) and invalid against v2 only because of the added required fields; the compatibility test proves both directions.
commands: uv run --extra test python -c "import json;[json.load(open(p)) for p in ('schemas/governed_execution/macro_packet.v2.schema.json','schemas/governed_execution/execution_binding.v2.schema.json')];print('PARSE_OK')"
validation: PARSE_OK; no v1 property removed or retyped (asserted by test_manifest_and_compatibility).

steps.task: Publish task_packet.v2 and the five receipt schemas.
requirements: task_packet.v2: superset of docs/03-reference/spec/dopetask/dopetask-canonical-spec.json (every v1 field retained, same required set) plus required: schema_version const dopemux.governed_execution.task_packet.v2; macro_id; workstream_id; risk_lane ($ref); audit_group; execution_requirements {preferred_route {runner,model,effort}, allowed_fallbacks[], binding: const LIVE_PROOF_REQUIRED, auditor_independence ($ref independence_class)}; write_surface (array of literal paths or terminal dir prefixes ending in /); canonical_writers (array, minItems 1); semantic_scope (array); rollback_boundary (string); operator_gate_required (boolean); receipt_refs (object of optional {path,sha256} refs keyed admission, writer_custody, freeze, finality); authority const NONE.

admission_receipt.v1: schema_version const; packet_id; packet_sha256; macro_id; separate validity fields each $ref status_class: schema_validity, authority_validity, classification_validity, audit_validity, execution_validity (I17); admission_status ($ref status_class) with description stating it is derived and fail-closed; is_execution_authority const false; dcp_route_decision_ref; task_orchestrator_item_ref; recorded_at; authority const NONE.

writer_custody_receipt.v1: schema_version const; packet_id; repo_identity {origin_url, toplevel}; worktree_path; branch; base_sha (git_oid); allowed_paths (array minItems 1); allowlist_digest (sha256); writer_identity {runner, session_ref, agent_role}; writer_lease {issued_at, expires_at, lease_id}; diff_provenance {base_sha, head_sha, patch_sha256}; rollback_locality {strategy enum REVERT_COMMITS|DELETE_BRANCH|RESET_TO_BASE, boundary string}; filesystem_scope {root, outside_root_writes: const false}; custody_state enum {HELD,RELEASED,AMBIGUOUS}; authority const NONE.

freeze_receipt.v1: schema_version const; packet_id; macro_id; repo_identity; base_sha; head_sha; tree_sha (git_oid); substantive_paths (array minItems 1); substantive_path_digest (sha256); candidate_digest (sha256); validation_refs (array of {path,sha256}, minItems 1); review_refs (array of {path,sha256}); frozen_at; freeze_state ($ref); supersedes_freeze_ref (optional {path,sha256}); no_audit_before_freeze const true; authority const NONE.

finality_receipt.v1: schema_version const; packet_id; macro_id; freeze_ref {path,sha256}; audit_receipt_ref {path,sha256}; audited_head (git_oid); finality_head (git_oid); exact_head_equality const true with description that audited_head must equal finality_head (asserted by test, not by schema); audit_verdict ($ref); pr_ref (string); steward_readiness enum {READY,NOT_READY,UNKNOWN,NOT_RUN}; merge_authorized const false; activation_authorized const false; recorded_at; authority const NONE.

aggregate_return_envelope.v1: schema_version const; macro_id; macro_status ($ref); workstreams (array minItems 1 of {workstream_id, status ($ref workstream_status), subject_sha (git_oid or literal NONE), return_ref {path,sha256}}); join_results (array of {join_id, join_type ($ref), satisfied boolean, affected_workstreams[], unaffected_workstreams[]}); model_calls {team_lead, implementers, auditors, total} integers; mcp {preflight, servers_used[], tools_used[], domain_reads integer, domain_writes integer, fallbacks[], task_orchestrator_state}; github_mutations integer; drift_classifications (array of {subject, class ($ref drift_class)}); blockers[], unknowns[], residual_risks[]; operator_gates_used[], operator_gates_needed[]; merge_authorized const false; activation_authorized const false; next_legal_action string; authority const NONE; is_canonical_truth const false.
commands: uv run --extra test python -c "import json,glob;[json.load(open(p)) for p in glob.glob('schemas/governed_execution/*.json')];print('PARSE_OK', len(glob.glob('schemas/governed_execution/*.json')))"
validation: PARSE_OK 11 (enums, manifest, macro v2, binding v2, task_packet v2, five receipts, aggregate envelope).

requirements: conftest.py builds a referencing.Registry from every schema in schemas/governed_execution/ keyed by $id and exposes a validator factory (Draft7Validator with that registry).

fixtures/valid/<schema>.json: at least one valid instance per schema (11 minus manifest = 10). fixtures/invalid/<schema>__<reason>.json: at least three per schema covering a missing required field, an undeclared field, and an enum/pattern violation; FinalityReceipt additionally audited_head != finality_head; FreezeReceipt additionally empty substantive_paths; AdmissionReceipt additionally is_execution_authority true.

test_schema_fixtures.py: parametrised; every valid fixture validates; every invalid fixture fails with at least one error; every schema declares additionalProperties false at every object level (walk the schema).

test_manifest_and_compatibility.py: manifest sha256 entries match file bytes at HEAD; kit v1 schema sha256 match the ADOPTED entries; every v1 property in the kit schemas exists in the v2 successor with equal type; the kit's own template instances (.control-tower/templates/*.json) validate against kit v1 and fail v2 only on missing new required fields (assert error paths are within the added-field set); enum values used anywhere in any schema are drawn from enums.v1 (no inline duplicate enum literal lists).

test_dag_and_authority.py: a MACRO fixture (macro_packet v2 valid instance modelling W01..W08 with the section 8 DAG and section 9 parallel group A) is acyclic, every dependency id resolves, W02/W03/W04/W05 write_surface prefixes are pairwise disjoint, W06 depends on W02 and W04, W07 on W04 and W06, W08 on W07; authority-collision: no two workstreams share a canonical_writer with overlapping write_surface; no schema in the set defines a property named merge_ready, dispatch_eligible, approved, or ready (placeholder-for-authority scan).
validation: All tests pass; ruff clean; at least 40 invalid fixtures and 10 valid fixtures exist.

requirements: docs/03-reference/governance/governed-execution-contract-v2.md uses the same YAML frontmatter shape as sibling files in docs/03-reference/governance/ (id, title, type, owner, author, date, last_review, next_review, prelude) and passes the repo docs hooks. Content: terminology, the section 2 invariants as they bind these schemas, authority ceilings (every schema authority NONE; who may issue what), schema table with versions and status, v1->v2 compatibility and deprecation rule, the freeze lifecycle FROZEN -> UNFREEZE -> REPAIR -> REVALIDATE -> REVIEW_SETTLE -> NEW_FREEZE, exact-head rule, and the non-colliding relationship to schemas/dcp/governed_execution_receipt.schema.json and the kit v1 schemas.
Run the full commit.verify list; every line exits 0. Commit per coherent slice with the packet commit.message prefix; no push.
